scope: source-only technical evidence; no training/activation/provider calls
timePolicy: event game time<=frame clock; event/rule knownAt<=original frame receipt with nanosecond precision; current dynamics from one coherent map/profile; explicit event patch contradiction rejected
historyPolicy: historical Roshan/style aggregates use completed prior maps available by frozen as-of cutoff; current-map events absent before play

sourceEvidence.scope: one retained map, 15 frames, literal countdown-shape examples; not semantics or SLA
previously retained game-resource mirror excerpts; not exact patch/build of arbitrary archived maps

definitions.name: roshan_timer_raw
definitions.formula: literal scoreboard.roshan_respawn_timer
definitions.requiredInputs: coherent Steam GLG scoreboard field

definitions.name: roshan_timer_positive
definitions.formula: 1 when literal timer>0, 0 when observed zero; no life inference
definitions.requiredInputs: roshan_timer_raw

definitions.name: roshan_timer_decreasing_pair
definitions.formula: abs((prior_timer-current_timer)-(current_clock-prior_clock))<=2 across positive timers and advancing clocks
definitions.requiredInputs: preceding coherent same-map/profile timer and game seconds

definitions.name: roshan_elapsed_since_confirmed_death
definitions.formula: current_game_seconds-confirmed_death_game_seconds
definitions.requiredInputs: confirmed same-map/profile death event known no later than receipt

definitions.name: roshan_respawn_lower_seconds
definitions.formula: max(0,patch_respawn_minimum_seconds-elapsed_since_confirmed_death)
definitions.requiredInputs: confirmed death plus exact qualified patch/profile rules

definitions.name: roshan_respawn_upper_seconds
definitions.formula: max(0,patch_respawn_maximum_seconds-elapsed_since_confirmed_death)
definitions.requiredInputs: confirmed death plus exact qualified patch/profile rules

definitions.name: roshan_confirmed_countdown_seconds
definitions.formula: positive literal timer<=qualified maximum, only with separate timer-semantics attestation
definitions.requiredInputs: exact patch/profile rules and independently attested countdown semantics

definitions.name: roshan_inferred_death_game_clock_lower_seconds
definitions.formula: current_clock+attested_timer-respawn_maximum
definitions.requiredInputs: same attested timer and patch rules; this is an interval, not a confirmed death

definitions.name: roshan_inferred_death_game_clock_upper_seconds
definitions.formula: min(current_clock,current_clock+attested_timer-respawn_minimum)
definitions.requiredInputs: same attested timer and patch rules; this is an interval, not a confirmed death

definitions.name: roshan_inferred_elapsed_since_death_lower_seconds
definitions.formula: max(0,respawn_minimum-attested_timer)
definitions.requiredInputs: same attested timer and patch rules; this is an interval, not a confirmed death

definitions.name: roshan_inferred_elapsed_since_death_upper_seconds
definitions.formula: respawn_maximum-attested_timer
definitions.requiredInputs: same attested timer and patch rules; this is an interval, not a confirmed death

definitions.name: roshan_dead
definitions.formula: 1 with qualified positive countdown or confirmed death before earliest patch respawn; 0 only with fresh explicit alive/respawn event
definitions.requiredInputs: causal event or separately attested timer+rules

definitions.name: roshan_alive
definitions.formula: 1 only for confirmed alive/respawn event at the exact current game clock; 0 when dead is qualified; otherwise null
definitions.requiredInputs: fresh same-map/profile alive event or qualified dead proof

definitions.name: roshan_confirmed_death_count
definitions.formula: count unique accepted death event IDs; zero unknown, never spawn ordinal
definitions.requiredInputs: retained causal death events

definitions.name: aegis_observed_in_slot
definitions.formula: 1 for exactly one observed slot matching attested item ID; absence stays null
definitions.requiredInputs: coherent current inventory slots and qualified patch/profile item mapping

definitions.name: aegis_holder_side
definitions.formula: +1 Radiant/-1 Dire of the single current observed holder
definitions.requiredInputs: coherent current inventory slots and qualified patch/profile item mapping

definitions.name: aegis_holder_hero
definitions.formula: current observed holder hero ID
definitions.requiredInputs: coherent current inventory slots and qualified patch/profile item mapping

definitions.name: aegis_holder_nw
definitions.formula: native net worth of current observed holder
definitions.requiredInputs: coherent current inventory slots and qualified patch/profile item mapping

definitions.name: aegis_holder_level
definitions.formula: native level of current observed holder
definitions.requiredInputs: coherent current inventory slots and qualified patch/profile item mapping

definitions.name: aegis_elapsed_since_confirmed_pickup
definitions.formula: current game clock-confirmed pickup clock, only while no linked terminal event has been accepted
definitions.requiredInputs: same-map/profile pickup with side/account identity

definitions.name: aegis_lifetime_upper_seconds
definitions.formula: max(0,qualified lifetime-elapsed since pickup); not proof of current possession
definitions.requiredInputs: confirmed pickup plus qualified patch/profile lifetime rule

definitions.name: aegis_confirmed_steal
definitions.formula: 1 when accepted pickup references accepted death, death_time<=pickup_time and sides differ; 0 when the same linked sides match; otherwise null
definitions.requiredInputs: causally linked death+pickup and confirmed kill/pickup sides

definitions.name: aegis.status=aegis_consumed
definitions.formula: accepted terminal event must reference current pickup ID and occur no earlier than pickup
definitions.requiredInputs: qualified terminal objective event

definitions.name: aegis.status=aegis_expired
definitions.formula: accepted terminal event must reference current pickup ID and occur no earlier than pickup
definitions.requiredInputs: qualified terminal objective event

definitions.name: aegis.status=aegis_destroyed
definitions.formula: accepted terminal event must reference current pickup ID and occur no earlier than pickup
definitions.requiredInputs: qualified terminal objective event

definitions.name: aegis_confirmed_consumed
definitions.formula: 1 only for an accepted linked consumed terminal receipt for the retained pickup; other statuses unknown, never false zero
definitions.requiredInputs: same retained pickup identity plus accepted terminalEvent

definitions.name: aegis_elapsed_since_confirmed_consumed
definitions.formula: current game seconds-confirmed consumed event game seconds for retained pickup
definitions.requiredInputs: same retained pickup and accepted terminalEvent

definitions.name: aegis_confirmed_expired
definitions.formula: 1 only for an accepted linked expired terminal receipt for the retained pickup; other statuses unknown, never false zero
definitions.requiredInputs: same retained pickup identity plus accepted terminalEvent

definitions.name: aegis_elapsed_since_confirmed_expired
definitions.formula: current game seconds-confirmed expired event game seconds for retained pickup
definitions.requiredInputs: same retained pickup and accepted terminalEvent

definitions.name: aegis_confirmed_destroyed
definitions.formula: 1 only for an accepted linked destroyed terminal receipt for the retained pickup; other statuses unknown, never false zero
definitions.requiredInputs: same retained pickup identity plus accepted terminalEvent

definitions.name: aegis_elapsed_since_confirmed_destroyed
definitions.formula: current game seconds-confirmed destroyed event game seconds for retained pickup
definitions.requiredInputs: same retained pickup and accepted terminalEvent

definitions.name: aegis_confirmed_terminal_event_count_for_retained_pickup
definitions.formula: 1 when the retained pickup has an accepted linked terminal receipt; unknown otherwise; repeated frames do not increase the count
definitions.requiredInputs: same retained pickup and accepted terminalEvent

definitions.name: Roshan/Aegis x lead x historical_closing_style
definitions.formula: qualified existing objective operand * same-frame Radiant-Dire lead * frozen historical same-side duration/late/kill-pace statistic
definitions.requiredInputs: objective operand plus coherent lead and supported as-of team history

definitions.name: Roshan/Aegis x economic_distribution x hero
definitions.formula: qualified existing objective operand * coherent player resource concentration or oriented literal hero net worth * optional frozen closing style
definitions.requiredInputs: objective operand, complete same-frame native metrics and optional supported history

remainingEvidenceGates: Exact patch/build-qualified rules and Aegis item mapping; letters remain separate versions
Same-map source-backed death/respawn/pickup/terminal event producer, causal IDs and availability receipts
Independent native timer semantics attestation; descending timer alone insufficient
Actual holder/item coverage with incomplete slots and conflicting candidates handled
Historical objective-to-end/lead-conditioned closing requires prior live trajectories and subsequently known labels; final scores alone insufficient
Prospective jointly eligible primitive-source denominator by profile/phase, distinct maps, delay and receipt age separated
notInferred: Latest successful HTTP response means new source state
Aegis inventory presence means Roshan killer or pickup time
Aegis disappearance in partial inventory means consumed/expired
Lifetime upper bound zero means observed terminal event
Final postmatch aegis_snatched value was known in earlier live
Confirmed death count equals full game spawn ordinal
